SELECT A.title, N.user_id, N.type, N.message, N.is_read, N.created_time, N.related_id FROM AUCTIONS A JOIN NOTIFICATIONS N ON A.auction_id = N.related_id WHERE N.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY N.created_time DESC
